# Moonshot launches Kimi K2.6

Chinese AI lab Moonshot AI launched Kimi K2.6 this week, according to the company's own [announcement post](https://moonshot.example/blog/kimi-k2-6).

The lab said the model supports a context window of 256k tokens. Analysts quoted by this site called the release incremental but useful, with the main gains in coding and long documents.

Several outlets reported the launch as happening on 2026-10-21, a day after the date the company gives on its own site, which most likely reflects time zones. We have asked Moonshot to confirm.

## What comes next

Speculation about a Kimi K3 is already running on forums, see the thread [Kimi K3 rumours](https://forum.example/t/kimi-k3-rumours), but the company has not confirmed anything about a successor. Readers should treat dates mentioned there as unverified until Moonshot speaks.

This article was written from the company's announcement and does not include independent testing of the model.
